description: Flutter Mobile Doctor Features: Implement complete doctor mobile experience including login (email/password + Google Sign-In), first-login password reset, device verification, dashboard with booking stats, bookings list with check-in/checkout buttons, and commission display. Backend APIs already exist for all operations.
steps: 1. Update mobile/pubspec.yaml: Add dependencies device_info_plus: ^9.1.0, google_sign_in: ^6.2.1, uuid: ^4.0.0, shared_preferences: ^2.2.2. Run flutter pub get.

2. Create mobile/lib/services/device_service.dart: Implement getOrCreateDeviceId() using shared_preferences + uuid package, getDeviceName() using device_info_plus (e.g., 'iPhone 14 Pro', 'Samsung Galaxy S23'), getDeviceType() returning 'MOBILE_IOS' or 'MOBILE_ANDROID'.

3. Create mobile/lib/services/api_client.dart (or modify if exists): Add interceptor to inject X-Device-ID and X-Device-Name headers on every request. Read token from flutter_secure_storage, add Authorization: Bearer ${token} header.

4. Create mobile/lib/services/google_auth_service.dart: Wrap GoogleSignIn package, implement signInWithGoogle() that gets ID token and sends to backend /api/auth/google/mobile (NOTE: This endpoint must be created in backend, not in this FEAT). Return Bearer token from backend, store in flutter_secure_storage.

5. Create data models in mobile/lib/features/doctor/data/models/: doctor_model.dart (parse user + doctor profile from /api/auth/me), booking_model.dart (parse from /api/doctor/bookings), device_model.dart (device info structure).
6. Create domain entities in mobile/lib/features/doctor/domain/entities/: doctor.dart, doctor_booking.dart (pure Dart classes, no JSON serialization).

7. Create repositories in mobile/lib/features/doctor/data/repositories/: doctor_auth_repository.dart (login, logout, checkSession, changePassword methods), doctor_booking_repository.dart (getBookings, checkIn, checkOut methods calling api_client).
8. Create datasources in mobile/lib/features/doctor/data/datasources/: doctor_remote_datasource.dart (HTTP calls to backend APIs), doctor_local_datasource.dart (cache bookings in shared_preferences).
9. Create use cases in mobile/lib/features/doctor/domain/usecases/: login_doctor.dart, checkin_patient.dart, checkout_patient.dart, get_doctor_bookings.dart (each wraps repository method).

10. Create Riverpod providers in mobile/lib/features/doctor/presentation/providers/: doctor_auth_provider.dart (StateNotifier managing auth state, user, token), doctor_bookings_provider.dart (FutureProvider for bookings list, methods for check-in/out).

11. Create screens in mobile/lib/features/doctor/presentation/screens/: doctor_login_screen.dart (email/password form + Google button), first_login_password_screen.dart (old password, new password, confirm fields → POST /api/auth/change-password-first-login), device_verification_screen.dart (6-digit OTP input → POST /api/auth/verify-device), doctor_dashboard_screen.dart (shows today's booking stats), doctor_bookings_screen.dart (ListView of BookingCard widgets), patient_checkin_screen.dart (booking detail with check-in/out buttons).

12. Create widgets in mobile/lib/features/doctor/presentation/widgets/: booking_card.dart (Card showing date, time, patient name, status, buttons), checkin_button.dart (calls POST /api/doctor/checkin, shows loading spinner), commission_display.dart (shows commission amount after checkout).

13. Update router (likely mobile/lib/router.dart or mobile/lib/core/router.dart): Add routes /doctor/login, /doctor/dashboard, /doctor/bookings, /doctor/checkin/:bookingId, /doctor/verify-device, /doctor/change-password. Add redirect logic: if passwordResetRequired === true redirect to change-password, if device not trusted redirect to verify-device.
14. Test on Android emulator: flutter run, test login → first-login password reset → device verification → dashboard → bookings list → check-in → check-out → commission displayed.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor can login with email/password from mobile app and see dashboard
Doctor can login with Google Sign-In button (requires backend endpoint from FEAT-001)
First-login redirect to password change screen works, password change successful
New device triggers OTP flow, device verification screen accepts OTP and marks device trusted
Dashboard displays today's booking count, pending check-ins count, completed count
Bookings list shows all appointments with patient names, dates, times, statuses
Check-in button updates booking status to include checkedInAt timestamp
Check-out button calculates commission automatically (backend), displays commission amount and centerEarnings in UI
All API calls include X-Device-ID, X-Device-Name, Authorization headers
verification: flutter run (on Android emulator or iOS simulator)
Test email/password login: Enter doctor credentials, tap Sign In → redirected to change password (if first login) → enter OTP from email → redirected to dashboard
Test dashboard: Verify booking stats are displayed correctly (today's count, pending, completed)
Test bookings list: Tap on bookings menu → see list of appointments
Test check-in: Tap check-in button on confirmed booking → status changes, checkedInAt timestamp shown
Test check-out: Tap check-out button on checked-in booking → commission calculated, displayed on screen
Check database: SELECT * FROM bookings WHERE id = 'booking_id' → checkedInAt, checkedOutAt, commissionAmount, centerEarnings populated
Test Google Sign-In: Tap Google button → redirects to Google → returns to app → logged in (requires FEAT-001 backend endpoint and Firebase setup)
findings:
Implementation complete. All Flutter doctor features implemented including:

1. Dependencies added: device_info_plus, google_sign_in, uuid, shared_preferences
2. Services: DeviceService, ApiClient with device headers, GoogleAuthService
3. Data layer: Models (DoctorModel, BookingModel, DeviceModel), Repositories, Datasources
4. Domain layer: Entities (Doctor, DoctorBooking), Use cases
5. Presentation layer: Providers (DoctorAuthProvider, DoctorBookingsProvider), Screens (Login, Dashboard, Bookings, Password Change, Device Verification, Patient Check-in), Widgets (BookingCard, CommissionDisplay, CheckinButton)
6. Router updated with doctor routes

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Google Sign-In mobile backend endpoint /api/auth/google/mobile is referenced but must be created in FEAT-001 (backend). Current implementation calls this endpoint and will fail gracefully if not available.
- Firebase configuration for Google Sign-In (SHA-1 fingerprint) must be set up in Firebase Console for production use.
- Device tracking is fully implemented and will send X-Device-ID, X-Device-Name headers on all API calls.
- Commission calculation happens automatically on checkout via backend API.
- Testing requires Android emulator or iOS simulator (flutter run) which was not available in this environment.
- All code follows Flutter clean architecture with Riverpod for state management.
